description: Draft a reply to an email using the configured local AI model. Returns plain text body ready to pass to reply_email. Does not send — use reply_email to review and send.

goal.description: Optional instruction for how to reply, e.g. "decline politely", "ask for more details", "confirm receipt". If omitted, the model writes a neutral professional reply.

message_ref.description: Composite message reference from list_emails or search_emails.

name: draft_reply
